visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens on a toddler boy with short dark hair sitting in a white high chair in a modern kitchen. He is wearing a brown long-sleeved shirt and a pink rabbit-themed bib. He holds a small green tube in his right hand while reaching for a black and grey water bottle with his left. The scene cuts to a woman with brown hair in a blue striped shirt showing intense surprise and joy with her mouth wide open. (2) The mother feeds the toddler medicine using a small plastic cup and a syringe while he remains in his high chair. He opens his mouth cooperatively and laughs joyfully. Numerous Traditional Chinese variety-style text overlays appear across the screen to emphasize the emotions. A circular inset frequently shows the mother in a denim jacket making a peace sign and smiling warmly at the camera. (3) A flashback montage transitions through several scenes showing the toddler at an earlier age. He is first seen in a wooden crib with colorful toys, then sitting on a floor, and finally secured in a car seat. The video returns to the present with a close-up of the child laughing heartily as a circular mask closes in on his face to end the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched toddler voice saying 'Mama' repeatedly. This is immediately followed by a loud, high-arousal female cheer of surprise and excitement. The background music is a bright acoustic pop track with rhythmic guitar strumming and a steady percussion beat. A sharp 'ding' SFX marks a transition to the mother's vocal praise. (2) A melodic female voice encourages the toddler during medicine feeding. A 'pop' sound effect is heard as the syringe is used. The acoustic guitar BGM continues with a warm and positive vibe. The mother’s vocal intensity is high, projecting joyful approval. The speech-music overlap is continuous and well-balanced throughout the sequence. (3) The recording quality shifts to lower fidelity as a flashback sequence plays. The toddler is heard saying 'A-dai' with a flat, repetitive pitch while background room tone and car interior hum are audible. The sequence concludes with the return of the upbeat BGM and the toddler’s loud, joyful laughter and clear 'Mama' exclamations.
